name: Lookalike Domain Monitor | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Lookalike Domain Monitor
Every day searches public certificate logs (Certificate Transparency, via crt.sh) for new domains that contain or imitate your brand, such as acme-login.com, acrne.com or punycode lookalikes. They are often set up for phishing before an attack. New ones are scored, logged and emailed so you can warn staff, block them and ask for a takedown.
The first run lists every existing match; after that only new ones.
1. Fill in **Settings**. 2. Make a sheet with a **Lookalike domains** tab (`lookalike-domains-sheet.csv`). 3. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail. 4. Activate.
